body_en:
My Salutations to all Pious Souls...

Now, you must be wondering who are my dear sadhaks. All of them who are there, always obey the 'Guru's orders' – I don't even have to give them any 'clarification' about why it needs to be done.

They always follow the rules about programmes, ashram rules, and do not take inappropriate advantage of their closeness to me. They neither complain about others nor is any complaint received about them from anyone.

They have full faith in me and accept that whatever changes are made in the arrangements are certainly as per today's needs. As and when we receive new experiences in the administration, we need to make changes accordingly. You too would like to become such a sadhak, wouldn't you?

Lots of Blessings to all of you.

Your own
Baba Swami
